design: Seven 2x2 diagnostic blocks plus seven paired simple controls
cost_boundary: unmeasured; no proxy is treated as completed-task cost
scope: Diagnostic fixed synthetic screen; not a population estimate, causal attribution proof or equivalence study.
stop: Execute all42 allocated trials once. Keep all attempts. Fix harness faults with explicit invalidation and replay accounting; never retry a subject failure to seek a pass.
outcome: Independent contract requirements. Strict pass requires every requirement; partial fraction is descriptive and cannot offset a failed guard.

blocks.scope: Delivered code and regression behavior at a public file-format boundary.
Audit decisions, independently justified test oracles and preservation under read-only authority.
Architecture and planning output; execution quality of the proposed implementation remains unmeasured.
An actual local browser artifact and bounded journey mapping; no external design-tool transfer.
Source-grounded inference from supplied data; live search acquisition and actual campaign execution are outside this block.
Two distinct writing deliverables; the pairing tests composition coverage, not an assumed single-document synergy.
Handoff and evidence decisions only. Native dispatch, lifecycle effects, model routing and end-to-end delivery effectiveness remain untested.

browser_preflight.reason: No installed Chromium/Chrome/Firefox executable. Isolated Playwright chromium-headless-shell download failed with a truncated/non-ZIP payload and lock error.
browser_preflight.impact: Real rendered UI, keyboard interaction and screenshot evidence cannot be claimed from source-only checks.

wrapper_template: Read the supplied task and work in its own fixture. Only assigned Assay skill snapshots may be used; none means ordinary platform/task instructions without supplied Assay. No other skill, grading key, previous answer or sibling workspace is an authorized input. This is an instruction boundary, not OS isolation.
